notes.title: Halls Twinstar is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/60108f84d463cc0ffa728303e53a8f88f1bd4ab2.png[/img]

Surviving a (regrettably) long stretch of development hell, the long-awaited continuation of the Valkyrie series is here!

Hall Twinstar has arrived, accessible via completing Butterfly Woods, and inside this update you'll find 8 brand new untiered items, several new crafting materials to hunt, and a handful of balance changes alongside the new dungeon. These include boosted Special drop rates from non-boss types and stronger barrier potions, as well as a bunch of other changes.

With music synced directly to the battle, Hall Twinstar is aimed to be more of a pattern to be learned and mastered. With less random dodging, there are only four different offset patterns you can learn optionally. Otherwise, reaction time and memory is enough to carry you through it after several attempts.

This dungeon is set within the upper bracket of our 'Experienced' difficulty tier, so I hope you stocked up on your speed dusts. You're going to need them.

Good luck, and enjoy your loot and oofs. Here's to the future next section of the valkyrie temples!

P.S.
If you don't have music enabled, I'll oof you myself

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/4364d82e84183f48d9989ff16c36fde8f2c3cc55.png[/img]


Aphrodite is back for another year of Valentine's Week! Unfortunately for her, her ex has come to the Dominion to find her! Take him on in the name of love and revenge!

The event starts today (2/15/25) and ends in 3 weeks on March 8th, 2025! Times are in PST.

Find new items, cosmetics, and more! Collect Love Essence from all intermediate+ bosses, and take it to Astake for unique rewards! Finish the Event Quest Attainments for some easier ways of getting even more rewards!

You'll find Thadacles in the Dominion, who will spawn after bosses spawn. He'll have his own event-specific quest marker to show you where he is!

Note: This is our first "smaller" event and will be what many future events will be. We've made this decision to ensure developer resources aren't taken away from permanent content and disrupt the flow of content development. We'll still be adding small things for each event. New in this event are event quest portraits, custom death messages, custom chat messages, and more! Please let us know what you think about it all.

[h2]Loot Announcement[/h2]
We're super excited to add a way of officially announcing to the world that you got a rare piece of loot! In items that are cosmetic+, you'll be able to announce to everyone in the instance that you got it! No more faking you got a white chest—announce it!

[h2]New Package[/h2]
As with all events, we released a new pack in the package shop! In future events, we'll come out with multiple and cheaper packs, but Jmn cooked too many good skins, and we didn't have time to split them into multiple packs with differing themes and cosmetics.

[h2]Event Shop[/h2]
We've got another Event Shop packed with limited-time skins, hats, and a pet! They're for gold and platinum. Buy them while they're here! They'll be removed at the end of the event.

[h2]EU Dominion[/h2]
The game has been exploding, and we're just as excited as everyone who has been playing! For a limited time, we'll be releasing an EU Dominion server. The Tavern server will still be based in the US, but the portals will connect to different regions. The specific region will be displayed on the portal name label itself.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/4e2e7410bdbd110aa7639cd29f7c69f88c2ac1a6.png[/img]
Wow! After a lot of work, Marigold is finally ready to open her Market (Board) for business! We've packed this update with a lot of other exciting changes that you can read about below!

[h2]Marigold's Market[/h2]
We are super excited to release our vision of a Market Board into Darza's Dominion! Please be sure to leave any and all feedback in our Discord. You'll find the Market is ran by Marigold. You can find her room northwest of the spawn in the Tavern.

Player-to-player trading will still exist if you choose, or list your items on the Market Board and wait for them to sell!



[h2]Market Fast Facts[/h2]
[list]
  [*]There is a 7.5% tax on all purchases, paid by the buyer and rounded down when applicable
  [*]You can pay Platinum to nullify the fee. The current rate is 1 platinum per 10,000 silver cost
  [*]Listings expire after 30 days
  [*]There is a limit of 24 listings per account
  [*]You can click the headers (e.g. Quantity) to sort by ascending or descending
[/list]

[h2]Silver[/h2]
Silver may be confusing to some so we're going to clarify and make it as simple as we can. Silver is Glory that can be used without dying on your character. You will still gain Glory on your character, and it will be converted to Silver on death. You can also gain Silver in various ways without dying. The Silver gained will go directly to your account balance.

Silver will drop directly from specific enemy types in Intermediate to Expert difficulty level encounters, dungeon chests, and more content in the future. Here's a range of Silver drops per type:
[list]
  [*]Dungeon Bosses: 3 - 121 silver
  [*]Regular Bosses: 2 - 103 silver
  [*]Mini Bosses: 1 - 85 silver
  [*]Dungeon Chests: 0 - 13 silver
[/list]
[h2]Silver Fast Facts[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Silver can be earned in various ways: Killing specific enemy types, dungeon chests, and more in the future
  [*]Silver is added directly to your account balance
  [*]Glory can be looked at as alive Silver
  [*]Silver is basically still Glory but can now be given without having to die
[/list]

[h2]Dropped For[/h2]
Have you ever wondered who originally owned the item you just bought on the Market Board or from another player? Starting today, you'll always know! From today forward, all items will have their original looter displayed at the bottom of the tooltip. It is denoted by the Spirit sprite followed by their name.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/6fad186662c9d2f718b2c3531583ad8d3bd487cd.png[/img]

This is a change we're all super excited about. It's simple but will be very cool to be able to flex that you looted all the items yourself.

[h2]Loot Shrine Changes[/h2]
We've made some changes to Loot Shrines that we want to mention upfront. It's no doubt that key sales make up a good portion of our income. When intitally implementing Loot Shrines we made the decision to remove them from key spawned dungeons. We're now reversing that decision and they will once again be available to dungeons opened via key. There are some changes, however!
[list]
  [*]Dungeons opened by key will cost 20 gold per 10% boost
  [*]Dungeons opened naturally (enemy spawn) will now cost 10 gold (down from 15) per 10% boost
[/list]
We believe this will make keys more attractive to players who wish to support us via key pops and shrine boosts, while making it cheaper for natural spawned dungeons.

[h2]Trick-or-Treating[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/e64620e32e52b4b2341fe721bed10f656dadabd4.png[/img]

Join us in the Tavern every real-life hour for a festive trick-or-treating activity! Collect candy, consumables, essence, and more! Keep an eye out for in-game announcements every hour indicating the start, and follow the shop vendors as they call out the next location!

[h2]Dominion Ghost Hunt[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/eb6345e46811429c491ab1a6b6cb4024449cc33f.png[/img]

Spooky times await! The Dominion is overrun with ghosts, and a global counter will track progress toward spawning the miniboss Ghasty. Team up with fellow adventurers to take down 66 Ghostys and earn a chance to fight Ghasty! After the event, Ghosty and Ghasty will linger in the new player biomes as Oyun and Astake work on banishing them.


[h2]Event Tiered Items[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/af242b17f38873d96ab6a0f87c6fdfbdf114450b.png[/img]

We've introduced a new tier: the Event tier. These items will have drop rates between Unique and Special items. We want everyone to have a chance to obtain Event tier items while keeping them rare enough to encourage trading. We're excited to launch 4 of them during The Hallowed Hunt! To make their drops feel extra special, we're also introducing new chests for each event. Old event items will get updated tiers and bag types in the future.

[h2]Quest Attainments + Essence Shop[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/858de0ca4b7f91d2f9434a866be6a3d10ebd8674.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/e691b1ab6d7a9c2855fad8cae53feca3842d15cc.png[/img]

We've heard your event feedback loud and clear! This event will feature easier quests to help you earn every reward at least once. For those who want to grind, Hallowed Essence will drop from every boss throughout the event!

We're also introducing a new Attainment type: The Hallowed Hunt attainment requires you to complete all other event-specific attainments to earn the final rewards—an exclusive “I Survived The Hallowed Hunt” title and three of Typ's Brain roll tokens!

[h3]Event Essence Slot[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/e691b1ab6d7a9c2855fad8cae53feca3842d15cc.png[/img]

In response to player feedback, we've added an event-specific essence slot! After discovering an event essence, it will automatically be equipped in an event slot. We hope this addresses player's concerns of having to drop stacks of work-in-progress essences!

[h2]Halloween-Specific Affixes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/b4eeece7867a8771e06b06bc6c6ab48ad03003d0.png[/img]

The special event tier items will drop with halloween-specific affixes! These will be rollable only during the event and will be removed from the pool afterward. However, items with these affixes will retain them permanently. Look out for their return next Halloween!

[h2]Event Gold Shop[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/b527fbbd5acb2f3a4b546c4e93fd7c2320c5196d.png[/img]

As with all events, we're offering limited-time gold shop items for our free-to-play players! Grab a spooky Gladiator skin, a pet version of the Pumpkin Lord, and a batty hat. They're available until The Hallowed Hunt ends, so don't miss out!

[h2]Spooky Package Return + New Graveyard and Witch Package[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/f4123d0a67e7d5e622edf1e88022ea40fdd35952.png[/img]

The Spooky Pack is back, and we're also introducing 2 brand packs, the Witch and Graveyard Package featuring amazing artwork by Jmn and Bee! Your support helps us continue this incredible journey together. Thanks a lot if you decide to buy them!

[h2]And More![/h2]
The event is packed with other goodies that aren't listed here. Go check out the latest update, The Hallowed Hunt, live on all platforms now!

notes.title: Rollin' Up To The Moon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/71cc1dcdee535d2041894e4f084add181b19888f.png[/img]
We're back! And we're rollin' up to the moon in the 5.2.0 update. We're introducing a few hype things: A totally redone Tavern, re-rolling of all equipment via Oyun's Rerolling Cauldron, a new tier of items we're calling 'Special', and an entirely new dungeon called the 'Alien Outpost' that is available via a new mini-boss named SPECIAL AGENT.

We've also got some exciting news for the future!

[b]Update: 5.2.0[/b]
[b]Release Date:[/b] 7/26/2024
[b]tl;dr:[/b] New developer, item rerolling, new dungeon, entirely remade Tavern, new tier of equipment, fixes, new mobile options, and more!
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[h2]New Developer[/h2]
We've got some exciting news to share! We'll soon be adding a new developer to the team. We're not ready to reveal who they are but we're excited to see what they're able to do! We'll be having them focus on bug fixing and quality of life improvements for the first few weeks as they learn the codebase.
[h2]Future Updates[/h2]
With this patch we're hoping to get back to weekly or biweekly updates so that we're always moving forward! Our new developer will surely help with this and the future is looking bright. Thanks to all of our players for riding with us.
[h2]Item Rerolling[/h2]
The in-game tooltip will describe this feature better than we will here but item rerolling will be a great glory sink for everyone! Affixes make equipment stronger and more appealing.

[h1]Darza’s Dominion: A Darzamas Miracle[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/5886805ad930304f579411f34e192a9a0145acef.png[/img]
Ho ho ho! It’s the most wonderful time of the year! Not only are we back, but Granta is too! Unfortunately, it’s been a while since he’s been to the Dominion and he got lost. It looks like he ended up trapped in the Reaper’s new Kingdom dubbed “The Reach”. Enter the Reach and rescue Granta Claus for some very generous rewards!

You can find The Reach at the end of every dungeon. For the duration of the event, and depending on the tier of dungeon (see below), a different portal will appear and depending on the tier, defeating the Reaper will drop presents. Open (destroy) the presents to progress the Attainments. Claim the rewards and open up the (real) presents to get an exclusive item! The specific Event Attainment titles give you a hint of what’s inside.
[h2]Event Details[/h2]
[list][*][b]Start:[/b] 12/29/2023 5PM PST
[*][b]End:[/b] 1/12/2024 5PM PST
[*]For the duration of the event, entering The Reach via the Tier 2 and Tier 3 portal will give you a chance at the regular Reaper’s loot pool.
[*]To see the Event Attainments, click/tap the double sword icon on your screen. Then click the Granta Claus event icon to see what we have in store![/list]
[h3]The Reach Tiers + Presents[/h3]
[b]Tier 1:[/b] Flower Thicket, and Trembling Giant
[list][*]2 Blue Presents
[*]1 Purple Present[/list]
[b]Tier 2:[/b] River Maze, Frost Cavern, Chasm of Dread, Infested Cellar, Primal Marsh, and Butterfly Woods
[list][*]2 Red Presents
[*]1 Green Present[/list]
[b]Tier 3:[/b] Harbinger's Oblivion, Shrine of Devas, Ancient Ruins, Rampant Citadel, and Axis of Trade
[list][*]2 Yellow Presents (4 drop Axis of Trade)
[*]1 White Present (2 drop Axis of Trade)[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Mobile Is Back![/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L0dftXFxhOE

MOBILE HAS RETURNED. YOU READ THAT RIGHT. ALONG WITH THIS GIANT UPDATE IS THE RERELEASE OF OUR MOBILE VERSION! FIND DOWNLOAD LINKS TO BOTH ANDROID AND APPLE IN OUR DISCORD + WEBSITE! Our game and community would be NOTHING without mobile. We cannot wait for our OG community to finally get their hands on the game after so long. This is just the beginning!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Words From The Team[/h1]

"It's finally here, after 5 years of ups and downs I'm proud to announce the 5.0 release for Darza's Dominon. I couldn't even code when I took over the project and now we have a game. This isn't the end, there's plenty of more updates to come! Appreciate all the love and support <3" - Linqx

"I still have the draft of an unreleased Producer’s Letter from January 2020. Early into it I shared the observation that the month that had preceded it, the month we’d originally planned to re-release, had felt “long, devastatingly long.” To this day I can remember my walk to the coffee shop that morning, the song I was listening to, and the long pause I took staring at those words after I’d placed them. The weight of this update being delayed has sat on our shoulders for a long time, and it’s not a small achievement for us to finally be able to share it with you. For the first time in four years we get to look toward the future, thank you for waiting!" - Typ

“I’ve been on the team since early 2018. Our track record has been lackluster but the time is finally here! I’m super excited for the future and I cannot wait for everyone to get their hands on this long-awaited update. 5 years in the making! Please do send all of your feedback to us and I’ll be sure it gets noted. This is just the beginning. Enjoy!” - Kyle

"went from being a normal player to making content on the team, so that’s cool. Axis of Trade is only the beginning, ur characters are not safe from me" - pocquette

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Affixes[/h1]
One of the biggest game changing features we’re launching with is Affixes. They truly change how the game is played and the feeling of looting tiered and untiered items.

When getting an equipment drop, you’ll now have the chance of it rolling from a group of Affixes specifically tailored to that slot type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/28790e1fb0c5adc283f30a7193b081a1745b1686.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/96d5a136e4624a65ac4a6a8dc3f7288b5f4193d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/58e9df908805cb5068b360c2c3883477e1c2171f.png[/img]

Planned for a Week 2 patch (spoilers), we’ll be introducing the ability to re-roll existing items. You’ll head over to Oyun, the Mystical who will work their magic and re-roll the affix of any item for a price. To give you ample time to farm, here are the prices for re-roll:
[list][*]Weapons: 100 glory per tier[/*][/list][list][*]Armors: 100 glory per tier[/*][/list][list][*]Abilities: 150 glory per tier[/*][/list][list][*]Accessories: 150 glory per tier[/*][/list][list][*]Unique/Relics: 1000 glory each[/*][/list]
As an example, re-rolling a T10 Weapon will cost you 1000 glory. If those prices seem to be too much for you, we have 2 options for you to make the prices free:
[list][*]Purchase a re-roll scroll from a vendor that sells it[list][*]We’re finalizing which vendors will sell it and will let you know[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Use any relic fragment in place of the re-roll scroll[/*][/list]

We are incredibly excited to see how everyone interacts with this system and all the build changes that will come with it. Please give us your feedback and let us know what you think!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Semreh and Attainments[/h1]
Semreh, the Curator enters the Tavern and with him comes a new whole new endgame system for players to enjoy. Semreh is a deity of trade, wealth, luck, and thieves. He wants to see you be your best and do your best. Complete over [b]1,000 unique attainments[/b] to compete to be on top of the all-time leaderboards. Doing so will place your character in the Tavern on his podium and give you a temporary gold/silver/bronze medal to wear on your characters to show your devotion.

Claim the score rewards to boost your position in the leaderboards, and purchase wares from his shop. What’s in store? Go see for yourself!

Note: Semreh’s Leaderboards and Shop will come in a future update. We’re keeping track of all score data so don’t fret!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/1220a4c137b856d21225e4ada5489ab65368b1ed.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/84faa55b73ef7cef9b3e55746db902ee52a9c49a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/01a050b4e1b0eeab5ecf4fc50cc7659531330307.png[/img]

[h2]Shield Attainments[/h2]
We ran into issues porting over the old Challenges feature, and decided to run a community poll in our discord to see what the best approach going forward would be. You all overwhelmingly voted on the option to reset everyone’s shield rank with the ability to regrind the new Shield Attainments for ~8810 gold in rewards!
[h2]No Hit Attainments[/h2]
In the Dungeon Attainments category, you will find numerous No Hit attainments. Completing a no hit has some rules that you can read about in the info button the these Attainments. I would like to quickly highlight them because they are a free-to-play path of getting pets that can be better than shop generator pets. On launch, every single dungeon will include a path to getting free-to-play pets. Each dungeon will have a stat split appropriate for the dungeon’s level.

[h1]Daily (Gold) Attainments[/h1]
With Semreh’s immense wealth, he is offering you 30 gold free a day just by completing his Daily Attainments. They are currently limited to:
[list][*]Completing dungeons
[*]Looting equipment
[*]Killing enemies[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/0a4ad26ac38c39919fb02cc232834292c0e9dd65.png[/img]

Daily Attainments reset at the same time daily for everyone. All players will have the same Daily Attainments to encourage cooperative play. New methods will come in the future but we want to ensure a smooth roll-out first.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]New Player + General Experience Improvements[/h1]
From keys dropping from bosses, the return of Daily (Gold) Attainments, every boss dropping a free Skin, and Attainment rewards dropping chests + free pets, we think we’re in a pretty good spot on the shop side of things for new players. Most importantly however, is the new player experience while playing the game itself. Below are some improvements that we plan on expanding indefinitely into the future.

[h2]New Player Dungeons[/h2]
Coming this update are 2 new player dungeons that both focus on a certain mechanic to introduce new players to. We’ve gone ahead and enabled essence for both of these dungeons so new players are introduced to the system earlier.

Our goal for all new player dungeons is to teach players brand new to the genre how to play it.
[h3]Trembling Giant[/h3]
A giant hollow tree filled with dangerous enemies await new players. But there’s a twist! The community loved Mara makes her return as a teacher. Instead of killing our beloved Mara, you’ll be greeted by her giant nuts to learn from and destroy for loot. She will teach you the basics of [b]enemy marking[/b], which is a new and interactive way of letting players know what they should be doing. Who would have guessed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/89400e745907f07e3b018ae9898b94fc9c7fd16a.png[/img]

[h3]Flower Thicket[/h3]
A beautiful but dangerous flower thicket with an angry Nymph will greet players when entering the Flower Thicket. This dungeon focuses on the [b]Bleed[/b] status effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/84d0c2fe47a44d5124a70ff824c9ff379a0264c0.png[/img]

[h2]New User Tutorial[/h2]
A much needed revamp of our Tutorial will be entering the game with this update. It covers nearly every topic there is: The Tavern, The Beyond, The Vault, The Dominion, various game systems, and UI. We hope this will be a welcome change! We do plan on adding a more interactive and less text based tutorial in the future. 

[b]Note for Returning Players:[/b] Everyone is required to do the Tutorial. When in the Dominion portion of the Tutorial, you are required to die by the “An Aspect of the Void”. [b]You will not actually lose your character.[/b] It is a fake death screen to transition people into The Beyond so we can explain it. Don't worry.

[h2]Reworked Experience[/h2]
Our goal is to have people cooperatively run dungeons, Raids in the future, and put themselves in more danger than running around the Mountains farming Glory in trains. While we have nothing against train farming, we think its a better experience to experience more than a train. To that end, we’ve changed a few things:
[list][*]Vastly increased experience gains in every dungeon.
[*]Added a boost of experience for killing quest bosses/enemies.
[*]Decreased glory gain across the board for Dominion enemies.
[*]Killing level-appropriate enemies will yield you more experience than not.
[*]Example: A level 17 Assassin will receive the most experience killing level 15-19 content, and not jumping directly to the Mountains and killing Gods.
[*]We'll be keeping a close eye on experience gain and adjust numbers accordingly. Be sure to post in our feedback channels if something doesn’t feel rewarding enough![/list]
[h2]Dungeon Keys[/h2]
To address numerous concerns regarding Dungeon Keys, we have elected to make them available in the Shop for [b]platinum only[/b]. This will result in nearly every key costing less money but not being available to purchase for Free 2 Play players using gold.

To make up for this, Dungeon Keys will now drop from all dungeon bosses. They will be [b]untradeable[/b].
[h3]Key Costs[/h3]
[list][*]Axis of Trade Dungeon: 3 platinum
[*]Advanced Dungeons: 2 platinum
[*]Intermediate Dungeons: 1 Platinum
[*]New Player Dungeons: Not Available[/list]
[h3]Key Adjustments[/h3]
To combat other concerns, Dungeons opened by keys will no longer:
[list][*]Spawn with a Loot Shrine in them
[*]Have the ability to drop additional Keys from the Boss[/list]
[h2]No Teleportation[/h2]
Despite some endgame dungeons spawning you in the boss room, it was never intended for people to sit in the spawn waiting for a few people to do the dungeon's objective (e.g. clear idols). Along with the aforementioned experience rates that will hopefully incentivize clearing, we have decided to disable player-to-play teleportation in the following dungeons:
[list][*]Harbinger's Oblivion
[*]Shrine of Devas
[*]Ancient Ruins
[*]Rampant Citadel
[*]The Void[/list]
Dungeons where you spawn in the boss room will be revamped in the future to make better use of this feature. However, we hope it will allow people to help others clear; especially given the massive increase to glory in all of these dungeons

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Bless Up[/h1]
Our 8th class enters the dominion! The Bishop is a Crosier wielding, Robe wearing, Element shooting class that restores Mana to all of those in his immediate presence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/4ec90c32482fbd0d6bae83522402b86a3afb522a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/5a443f338a59cbf84dc8c1c02529fa043a8d4ea9.gif[/img]

[b]You can unlock the Bishop by defeating the Rampant Bishop boss located in the Rampant Citadel dungeon![/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Status Effect Tiers[/h1]
Status Effect tiers are an exciting new feature that will allow immense build diversity between all of the item tiers. It will also allow enemies to dish out more impactful status effects depending on the tier of dungeon it is.
[list][*]Status Effects now have tiers! 1-5, with 5 being the best. A Unique item may start at Tier 3, while a low tier item will probably start at Tier 1.
[*]Another cool thing about these new Status Effects is that they stack! As an example, the Tier 6 Crosier (Bishop Ability) starts at Tier 2 Blessed. If 9 other Bishop’s use the same Crosier, the collective status effect a player will receive will be upgraded to Tier 3 Blessed.
[*]The same can be said about any status effect; whether given to enemies by players or to players by enemies. Gone are the days of mindlessly getting hit by status effect inflicting projectiles/bombs![/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Functioning Guilds![/h1]
We now have a functioning guild system! Promote, demote, and kick members from the new and improved Guild List Stand. You’ll be able to see when your guild was founded, your member and online counts, and your rank! Click on a Player to see when they were last online, or what server they’re currently on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/1440a6222c66496fee6d897b5f8e779ed937e6cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/b023a3d3b52cf8229c679097afe65ff2ed84048a.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Account Customization[/h1]
We want everyone in the Dominion to be able to express themselves in as many ways as possible. The start of this endeavor will be with the release of [b]Titles[/b] and [b]Emotes[/b]. There is plenty more planned, as you can see presented in the Account Customization menu, and we’ve got a bunch more we’re not quite ready to talk about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/744ee8731e314f1fc911c12fffba62765285223d.png[/img]

[h2]Titles[/h2]
Titles are a way to showcase your achievements. They can be earned through completing Attainments, or find them in Packages at Platino's Shop. We plan to release gold titles in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/b455b4165f92b75a30430ba97a28a3ade475930f.png[/img]

[h2]Emotes[/h2]
Emotes let you set the mood when something funny, annoying, crazy, or unbelievable happens. You can acquire them in the Shop or find them in Packages at Platino's Shop.

You can set up to 8 unlocked emotes at a time, on both Mobile and PC. In the UI itself, or in the shops, you can get several basic emotes for free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/e6cc14b05e0377a164dbf656c2b70aeeac7e85f3.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Let There Be Light![/h1]
One of the biggest system changes we made was the addition of an entire day and night system, which also introduces light sources and bloom.
[h2]Day and Night[/h2]
One of the most exciting features we’ve added for more immersion is a Day and Night system. While currently rudimentary in its implementation, we plan to fully take advantage of the system by adding time dependent enemy spawns and encounters in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/216682ec785fcccdb5f419d802a8bbb48af5bd7f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/149cf536d5bf604cded4fbae0c2ab6059f43866c.png[/img]

[h2]Lighting System[/h2]
One of the most immediately noticeable changes is the addition of our lighting system. Lights light up a dark area and give everything a vibrant appeal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/f00f2d3e2a761210fede61bee64b0917bf8152c1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/e4314fe6c44bbe344952709cc2b24dd729815134.png[/img]

[h2]Bloom[/h2]
The easiest way to describe bloom is by looking at examples. Bloom can be explained as a per pixel light that when used correctly increases the depth and immersion of the sprite its used in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/3e26e7cd4a87f106582dff0ac613f7c87d7aea8f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/0e973b30514df79b7482838a4436367faaafa7cd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/4ea6d3682d0ed523ecc1aec3ff59d06a47be0295.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Updated UI[/h1]
We’ve went through nearly all UI elements and updated them. We wanted to provide you with more information and a better experience and this round is just the start!
[h2]Essences[/h2]
While mobile has never even seen the old UI, the new UI provides the player with the boss sprites to quickly associate the essence with what items are available when you start collecting the essence. We’ve got a few more updates planned for Essences so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/c947abfd56df198af760682b661f7964f5c04b6e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/da4469109d07a61ae81a6672233f3257be26b2f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/55d3b8010cf591ef330119a14d10e50ea46e856e.png[/img]

[h2]Packages[/h2]
We’ve significantly improved the Package viewing and buying experience. Platino’s Shop also allows you to buy Keys in the UI itself instead of having to run to the shop! This will be apart of a much larger shop overhaul we have planned for the future

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/c8f491be4e73930e19c27a5f45ea8b5d1f247853.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Vesta Protects, Vesta Attacks[/h1]
One of the most unique, ambitious, and certainly hardest events and enemy has found her way to the Dominion! [b]Vesta, Axis Gatesguard[/b] is here to protect the Enraged Bulls and Axis of Trade from any intruders. Do you have what it takes to best her and enter Taurus’ domain?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/01e3c359c40663f24b39b8eb5b67f3892d1385c7.png[/img]

If you are lucky enough to best Vesta, your battle is only half over. Enter the Axis of Trade! The Dominion has its first [b]expert [/b]level dungeon and it’s a doozy. Fight through the hordes of angry onlookers, be chased to the Colosseum, and fight in one of the most epic battles Darza’s Dominion has ever faced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/3f3abf0265ba1c1de8420133c8a379585c2fc6d5.png[/img]

We won’t spoil what items these new bosses drop but we will say they are incredible both in sprite and in use.
[h2]A Gladiator Awaits…[/h2]
Semreh has a reward waiting but needs time to cook. Check back in a few days to see what’s in store…

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Public Trello[/h1]
In a week or two, we will open up a public Trello. The Trello will be a resource for players to see what we have planned for the future, what we're working on currently, and a place for us to highlight community ideas and suggestions we're considering.

[b]It is important to note that not every single plan or thing being worked on will be posted here. This board will be used to keep everyone in the loop and maybe even tailor our own internal discussions based on what you guys give us in feedback to the things posted there.[/b]

notes.title: Update 4.0.1: 2 Starting Character Slots, Fairy Forest, Loot Shrines, and More!
notes.notes:
Our first content update in a number of years! This update is focused on a lot of quality of life improvements players have been requesting. Also included in the update is a new default of 2 starting character slots for new and existing players (up from 1), a new dungeon, a new boss in an existing dungeon, loot shrines, and more! As always, our [url=https://discord.gg/darza]Discord[/url] is the best place to stay up to date on latest changes.


[h1]Mobile News[/h1]
For those of you who are playing our game for the first time, you may not know that we started out as a mobile game. We had aspirations of releasing on all platforms simultaneously but due to unforeseen issues, that was unfortunately not the case. We're excited for everyone to be able to play Darza's Dominion at home, on the go, [strike]in class[/strike], or anywhere you want!


With that said, we're happy to announce our intended, somewhat-firm-but-we're-0/10-on-mobile-release-dates, release date! [b]Our targeted mobile release date on both iOS and Android is May 13th.[/b] Which happens to be Friday the 13th... spooky.

[b]We want to make it clear the 13th is our best guess. It could come before or after. We will let everyone know on Discord if anything changes and when we can set the date in stone.[/b]

[h1]2 Character Slots Starting Out![/h1]
We've heard your feedback loud and clear and will be starting every account with 2 character slots instead of 1. Existing accounts will also be getting a free character slot in the form of a character slot unlocker! Use it to unlock whichever slot you choose. We initially wanted to go the route of a challenge to unlock this free slot but after feedback decided against it. Thanks as always for expressing your feedback constructively!

[h1]Fairy Forest[/h1]
A new mid-tier dungeon has entered the Dominion! Fight through a mushroom and fairy laden forest to fight Adelphi, Lower Valkyrie! Will you survive what lies amongst the trees, or will Adelphi best you with her heavenly blade? Fight her now by killing enemies in the mountains!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/75c802691e70e893aef72d2449aa7dd7865856e1.gif[/img]

[h1]Loot Shrines[/h1]
Before this update, players could buy 1 time use Loot Elixir potions that would increase [b]their own personal loot chances[/b] for 30 minutes. We wanted to introduce a system that was less pay to win, and allowed everyone in the specific dungeon you are in to reap the rewards of our community's kindness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/04a04da88070534e8325cc9bb4d212cce5b4c6f7.gif[/img]

Introducing the [b]Loot Shrine[/b]! In each dungeon you enter, there will be a Loot Shrine somewhere in the starting room.[b] Anyone in that dungeon[/b] can contribute 15 gold per Loot Shrine level for a 10% increase in loot chance for all enemies in that dungeon. There are 5 levels of increase, totaling a 50% total increase in loot chance. Detailed below are the increases.

[list]
[*] Base: 100% loot chance
[*] Level 1: 110% loot chance (15 gold spent)
[*] Level 2: 120% loot chance (30 gold spent)
[*] Level 3: 130% loot chance (45 gold spent)
[*] Level 4: 140% loot chance (60 gold spent)
[*] Level 5: 150% loot chance (75 gold spent)
[/list]

[h1]Class Item Changes[/h1]
[b]Mortars[/b] are receiving nerfs across the board (partially temporary until new tech for them is added):
[list]
[*] Radius through tiers is reduced (4.5 t0 / 4.5 t6 -> 2.0 t0 / 2.75 t6)
[*] Healing through tiers is reduced (70 t0 / 200 t6 -> 50 t0 / 180 t6)
[*] Mana Cost through tiers was standardized
[/list]

[b]Capes[/b] are receiving nerfs across the board:
[list]
[*] Effect radius through tiers is reduced (5 t0 / 6 t6 -> 3.25 t0 / 4 t6)
[*] Healing duration through tiers is reduced (2 t0 / 5 t6 -> 2 t0 / 3.5 t6)
[*] Mana costs have been reduced by 10 points on across tiers
[*] Self heal is 1.5 second longer than group healing duration
[/list]

[b]Darloc's Spite[/b] has been changed to hopefully become the go-to whip for DPS at the cost of some healing:
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 3.5 -> 1.5
[*] Damage: 500-690 -> 375-520
[*] Lifetime: 0.65 -> 0.75 (1 tile increase)
[*] Tether Duration: 3 -> 2
[/list]

The [b]Winter's Trinket[/b], [b]Betraying Hex[/b], and [b]Glacial Flurry[/b] have all been slightly reworked.

[h1]Ohtli enters the Ancient Ruins[/h1]
Did you think the 2 puny Cicipaltis were menaces? Just wait until you fight Ohtli after them. Go on, give it your best shot! We know you're always up for a challenge.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
A non-exhaustive list of changes we've made. Visit our discord, linked above, for a complete and updated list.

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The nearby character list no longer automatically updates and pauses when your cursor is on it
[*] You are now able to resize chat in the 'Gameplay' tab
[*] You are now able to turn off Public Chat in the 'Gameplay' tab
[*] You are now able to turn off Private Chat in the 'Gameplay' tab
[*] You are now able to turn off Ally Damage and Texts (e.g. status effects) above their heads in the 'Gameplay' tab
[*] Added a clearer verification message for new accounts.
[*] Speed formula changed, everyone is now effectively 10 speed faster
[*] The HP bar under your character will now probably say 0 when you die to not confuse anyone 
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Readded Reaper spawn to the Primal Marsh
[*] Significantly reducing the number of environmental objects in the cardinal regions (godlands)
[*] Reduced the size of certain objects blocking visibility
[*] Treelines (dark tiles) will not be affected for aesthetic purposes
[*] Significantly reducing the amount of large objects in miniboss setpieces
[*] (Frost Cavern) Gradevale, Mage of Winter will receive updated & more aggressive behaviors, including an enraged phase
[*] (Frost Cavern) Gradvale, Mage of Winter will receive a health nerf (40k -> 34k) on top of his aggressive behavior change
[*] The Molten South will receive a brightness increase to all rock objects to improve visibility
[*] Removed some excessive walls from specific rooms in the Chasm of Dread
[*] All of the dominion's small rocks will now be pass-thru instead of solid objects
[*] (Primal Marsh) Swapped Baby Circling Minions (the ones that follow Darloc) and Wandering Baby Minions (the 3 that wander around the boss room) shot patterns
[*] (Primal Marsh) Activated minions now flash until their death to clearly (hopefully) show which ones to attack next
[*] (Primal Marsh) During Rage Phase, you now need to kill the minion in the middle to make Darloc vulnerable (Thanks for the idea @Harrybaxter♫♫♩♫‿◦)
[*] (Primal Marsh) During Rage Phase, there should now be a gap between his last circling bullet and darloc himself to allow you to actually see Darloc
[*] (Primal Marsh) Made the first phase more melee friendly 
[*] (Primal Marsh) Changed the first phase of Darloc to be a little more interesting
[*] (Primal Marsh) Cut the damage of Big Croc Shots in half (300 -> 150) but they now armor pierce
[*] (River Maze) Reaper regions so it no longer spawns only in the beginning room
[*] (Infested Cellar) Spiders shooouuuldn't spawn within the inaccessible wine pools anymore
[*] (Infested Cellar) Athena, Queen of Arachnids will receive a health buff (32k -> 38k) and will soon receive more phases + an enraged phase
[*] (Infested Cellar) spiders will receive a small health nerf across the board
[*] (Ancient Ruins) Fixed Cicipalti's moving too fast / shooting too commonly due to server ticking issue
[*] (Ancient Ruins) Changed Dominus' large axe projectiles to no longer fire at pre-determined angles
[*] (Rampant Citadel) Fixed Cecil's large shots being able to nearly stack based off of erratic cooldown variable (also related to the ticking issue)
[*] (Shrine of Devas) Health Gems should appear more commonly from Crimson Asura
[*] Bumped event dungeon drop rates back up a bit (48% -> 55%)
[*] Consumables, Single Use items, and Unlimited Use items will have their tooltips fixed
[*] There are temporary floating tip lines describing how to trade with NPCs until a more sophisticated tutorial system is added to the game
[*] Village Traders & Mages are now labeled in the front of the doorways

[*] Setpieces for the Molten South's miniboss will contain less lava under the boss so you can get closer

[*] Added a new world drop skin to a certain godlands dungeon (thanks @Jaden [Bork])

notes.title: Free Gold, Vault Slot, and Character Slot Challenge
notes.notes:
A valid criticism a lot of new players have is how hard it is to play with only 1 vault and 1 character slot starting out. We've heard your criticism and are hoping to improve upon it! We really do value your constructive and valid feedback; you can expect us to adjust systems when presented with it.

Below are some details on existing features and future plans to address the most common concerns post-release. Thanks to everyone for reaching out.


[h1]Free Gold[/h1]

In Darza's Dominion, we currently have and are looking to vastly expand our Challenges system. As of now, you are able to complete Challenges and earn [b]8810 gold completely free[/b] just by playing the game.

[b]To get to the Challenges menu, simply click the two swords icon next to the minimap.[/b] I have completed many of the challenges but you can visit our wiki to see the uncompleted ones.

This feature is not mentioned at all and we are committed to making our new-player tutorial cover all of these topics so nothing is missed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/cc61f494eb0e047652b064007e469cfe6d5f161b.gif[/img]

[h1]Daily Gold Quests[/h1]

In a future update, we'll be adding Daily Gold Quests. A number of quests, a few easy and at least one hard, will randomly assign to you each day. Completing all of them will give you a maximum of 25 gold per day by just playing the game and completing the quests!

Besides Challenges, we want players to be able to have a free route of collecting gold. Please join our discord if you'd like to add to our growing list of daily quests.

[h1]Free Vault Slot[/h1]

Starting with the next server update (4/26/2022), we'll be increasing the starting number of Vault chests to 2 instead of 1. Existing created accounts will also get a free vault chest unlocker.

[h1]Character Slot Challenge[/h1]

In a future update, hopefully with the release of mobile, we'll be introducing a new challenge (name pending). This challenge will allow you to unlock a 2nd character slot entirely for free! This will be on top of already existing challenges and will not replace any gold given from those challenges.

We hope this will help alleviate the concerns of starting out with 1 character slot. The challenge will be geared towards leveling up and maxing a character. This should give it a natural progression to a new player just starting out.


[h1]Thanks[/h1]

We really do appreciate all of the feedback we've been getting on these topics and all of the other things as well. We'll continue to adjust our game based on feedback and hope y'all give it a try again in the future, or keep playing if you're enjoying it!

notes.title: Darza's Dominion has released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42220879/efe519093a5d996b52b4786fed56c61efc0954a5.png[/img]

After more than 2.5 years, Darza's Dominion makes its return! With a soft launch on PC, and mobile release coming shortly after, we're excited to finally let people back in Darza's Dominion.

We want to welcome all the new players and returning players to our game. We're just a small 5 man team and have put our heart into this game. Be sure to join our discord for server updates, game updates, and to connect with the community!
